# Design a Solution

Analyze the request and produce a design proposal only. First list ambiguities that affect correctness, data access, or environment selection. Do not call external tools or infer IDs, permissions, or organization policy.

Return: problem statement; scope; actors/personas; process; functional/non-functional requirements; proposed approved components; SharePoint, Power BI, and Power Automate designs; security; implementation/test/deployment plans; assumptions; open questions; risks; approval gates. Trace every metric and component to a requirement. No live writes or production targeting.
